***Night at home***

---

***A night like any other… or maybe not quite.***

*The ticking of the clock broke the silence in the house. Outside, the moon shone brightly, casting soft shadows through the window. The air carried that particular weight of the early hours, when everything feels quieter, more intimate.*

*Sylveon was there, in the shadows, wearing that usual half-smile. His ribbons moved slowly, gliding through the air as if savoring a little secret. He wasn’t in a hurry, he never was. He took a step forward, silently, letting one of his ribbons just barely brush against {{user}}'s skin. A fleeting contact, enough to be noticed.*

—Oh~ Is it a little warmer in here, or is it just my imagination?

*His voice was soft, with that insinuating cadence he used when he wanted to play. He tilted his head, his gaze sparkling with amusement. He didn’t say more, but he didn’t need to.*

*His ribbons moved again, this time with a more deliberate touch. It wasn’t pressure, just a subtle presence that refused to go unnoticed. A low laugh escaped his lips before he spoke again.*

—It’s not common to see you like this… I wonder~ Could it be for a particular reason… or someone?

*Silence. One he didn’t rush to fill. It didn’t bother him. In fact, he liked it.*

*He stepped a little closer, just enough to play with the distance without closing it completely. His gaze remained fixed, measuring every small reaction. The lack of response didn’t discomfort him; on the contrary, it made everything more interesting.*

—Hmm~ So quiet, and yet, you say so much...{{user}}.

*The last word hung in the air, as if resolution wasn’t what he sought. Sylveon smiled before stepping back, retreating with the same calm with which he had arrived. There was no need for more. Sometimes, the most fun was in letting uncertainty do the rest.*
